Name: Belphegor
Basic Side:
When one of your fire units wins combat: 
Gain a victory counter on this Emblem. Only two per Cycle.
Condition:
Four Rauhnacht-Feuergeister units contributed to four victory counters: 
Transform this Emblem.
Ultimate Side:
Rauhnacht-Feuergeister get +1 Attack Power during combat for each victory counter. 
After a goal, lose all counters and flip this Emblem back to it's basic side
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.

Name: Flauros
Basic Side:
When a fire unit alters the Attack or Defense of another fire unit: 
Give the unit with the changed stat +1 Attack during combat.
Condition:
Four Rauhnacht-Feuergeister units have fused with each other: 
Transform this Emblem at the end of combat.
Ultimate Side:
Create a permanent weapon token for one Star Unit. The weapons attack is the strongest fused unit.  
Break up all fused units and send them to the exhaust zone.
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.

Name: Buer
Basic Side:
When a fire unit recieves a counter: 
Give that fire unit on the field a + 1 Attack during their Combat (once per cycle)
Condition:
Eight Rauhnacht-Feuergeister have been active at some point: 
Transform this Emblem at the start of "Play Maker"
Ultimate Side:
Give the permanent Teufel Mask counter on a unit in the field zone and change its unit type to basic. 
When the unit is in combat, it obtains the Rauhnacht-Feuergeister unit type, and +1 Attack Power each counter on the Teufel Mask. 
After each combat give the unit with Teufel Mask - 1 Attack Power during combat. 
After the unit deals - 1 Attack Power during combat remove the Teufel Mask and return its unit type.
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.
